cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.
